correctness.rationale: Verified Ren–Chen Theorem 1.2's three classes and 40. With a=v2(N), their even forms have odd part q or q² and give N<2^(3a+2), including 40. For odd length, a=v2(d), so U_t<4d²<g^4 excludes every t≥5. For t=3, U_3 is odd, hence q or q², and g²<U_3<(g+1)² rules out a square. Then q>g>d forces d=2^a; the linear-exponent Ren–Chen forms have q<d or q<2d, the square form is impossible and 40 has odd part only 5. For t=2m≥6 the two factors U_m and g^m+1 have gcd dividing 2. For odd m, both U_m and the alternating quotient (g^m+1)/(g+1) are odd and greater than 1; for even m≥4, g^m+1 has 2-adic valuation 1 and an odd prime from g^(m/2)+1 divides U_m (it cannot divide g−1). Such a prime exists by valuation 1 for even m/2 or by the odd alternating quotient for odd m/2≥3. This gives two distinct odd primes plus 2. At t=4, gcd(g+1,g²+1) divides 2 and (g²+1)/2 is odd and >g, so g+1=2^s, s≥2. The odd part Q=(g²+1)/2 of U_4 is q or q²; no odd part can come from d by size in the prime case and exponent in the square case. Thus a≥s+1. The square form forces sqrt(Q)=2^(a+1)−1>g, impossible. For Q prime, Q≡1 mod 4 rules out the Mersenne form and forces k=1 in the remaining form. But Q+3 has valuation 2 with odd quotient >1 for s≥3, and equals 8<2^(a+1) at s=2. The sole witness has 40=1+3+9+27 and σ(40)=15·6=90; its redundancy 10 is proper and its prime support is {2,5}. No larger odd base can write 40 at length four. This is an analytic proof review; verify.py was inspected, not executed, and its bounded test is not needed for the infinite result.
residual_risks: Restricted to an odd base, a nonzero digit, length at least three, and exactly two distinct prime divisors.

value.rationale: A complete classification across unbounded odd bases is a meaningful improvement over a fixed four-base sieve. The result separates the binary valuation and the odd-prime obstructions, yielding a uniform theorem rather than rechecking the known example.
residual_risks: No classification of even bases, short repdigits or larger prime supports is implied.
